versos.hebraico: אִם־בַּמַּחְתֶּ֛רֶת יִמָּצֵ֥א הַגַּנָּ֖ב וְהֻכָּ֣ה וָמֵ֑ת אֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ דָּמִֽים׃

controles.web: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it, or sells it; he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
controles.kjv: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
controles.livre: Quando alguém furtar boi ou ovelha, e lhe degolar ou vender, por aquele boi pagará cinco bois, e por aquela ovelha quatro ovelhas.

versos.hebraico: אִם־זָרְחָ֥ה הַשֶּׁ֛מֶשׁ עָלָ֖יו דָּמִ֣ים ל֑וֹ שַׁלֵּ֣ם יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם אִם־אֵ֣ין ל֔וֹ וְנִמְכַּ֖ר בִּגְנֵבָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.
controles.kjv: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.
controles.livre: Se o ladrão for achado arrombando uma casa, e for ferido e morrer, o que lhe feriu não será culpado de sua morte.

versos.hebraico: אִֽם־הִמָּצֵא֩ תִמָּצֵ֨א בְיָד֜וֹ הַגְּנֵבָ֗ה מִשּׁ֧וֹר עַד־חֲמ֛וֹר עַד־שֶׂ֖ה חַיִּ֑ים שְׁנַ֖יִם יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃ס

controles.web: If the sun has risen on him, guilt of bloodshed shall be for him; he shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
controles.kjv: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
controles.livre: Se o sol houver sobre ele saído, o matador será réu de homicídio: o ladrão haverá de restituir completamente; se não tiver, será vendido por seu furto.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י יַבְעֶר־אִישׁ֙ שָׂדֶ֣ה אוֹ־כֶ֔רֶם וְשִׁלַּח֙ אֶת־בעירה וּבִעֵ֖ר בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה אַחֵ֑ר מֵיטַ֥ב שָׂדֵ֛הוּ וּמֵיטַ֥ב כַּרְמ֖וֹ יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃ס

controles.web: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.
controles.kjv: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.
controles.livre: Se for achado com o furto na mão, seja boi ou asno ou ovelha vivos, pagará o dobro.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־תֵצֵ֨א אֵ֜שׁ וּמָצְאָ֤ה קֹצִים֙ וְנֶאֱכַ֣ל גָּדִ֔ישׁ א֥וֹ הַקָּמָ֖ה א֣וֹ הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה שַׁלֵּ֣ם יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם הַמַּבְעִ֖ר אֶת־הַבְּעֵרָֽה׃ס

controles.web: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten, and lets his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.
controles.kjv: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man’s field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.
controles.livre: Se alguém fizer pastar campo ou vinha, e meter seu animal, e comer a terra de outro, do melhor de sua terra e do melhor de sua vinha pagará.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־יִתֵּן֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵ֜הוּ כֶּ֤סֶף אֽוֹ־כֵלִים֙ לִשְׁמֹ֔ר וְגֻנַּ֖ב מִבֵּ֣ית הָאִ֑ישׁ אִם־יִמָּצֵ֥א הַגַּנָּ֖ב יְשַׁלֵּ֥ם שְׁנָֽיִם׃

controles.web: “If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
controles.kjv: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
controles.livre: Quando irromper um fogo, e achar espinhos, e for queimado amontoado, ou plantação, ou campo, o que acendeu o fogo pagará o queimado.

versos.hebraico: אִם־לֹ֤א יִמָּצֵא֙ הַגַּנָּ֔ב וְנִקְרַ֥ב בַּֽעַל־הַבַּ֖יִת אֶל־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים אִם־לֹ֥א שָׁלַ֛ח יָד֖וֹ בִּמְלֶ֥אכֶת רֵעֵֽהוּ׃

controles.web: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief is found, he shall pay double.
controles.kjv: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.
controles.livre: Quando alguém der a seu próximo prata ou joias a guardar, e for furtado da casa daquele homem, se o ladrão se achar, pagará o dobro.

versos.hebraico: עַֽל־כָּל־דְּבַר־פֶּ֡שַׁע עַל־שׁ֡וֹר עַל־חֲ֠מוֹר עַל־שֶׂ֨ה עַל־שַׂלְמָ֜ה עַל־כָּל־אֲבֵדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֹאמַר֙ כִּי־ה֣וּא זֶ֔ה עַ֚ד הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים יָבֹ֖א דְּבַר־שְׁנֵיהֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַרְשִׁיעֻן֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים יְשַׁלֵּ֥ם שְׁנַ֖יִם לְרֵעֵֽהוּ׃ס

controles.web: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out if he hasn’t put his hand to his neighbor’s goods.
controles.kjv: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods.
controles.livre: Se o ladrão não se achar, então o dono da casa será apresentado aos juízes, para ver se pôs sua mão na riqueza de seu próximo.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־יִתֵּן֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵ֜הוּ חֲמ֨וֹר אוֹ־שׁ֥וֹר אוֹ־שֶׂ֛ה וְכָל־בְּהֵמָ֖ה לִשְׁמֹ֑ר וּמֵ֛ת אוֹ־נִשְׁבַּ֥ר אוֹ־נִשְׁבָּ֖ה אֵ֥ין רֹאֶֽה׃

controles.web: For every matter of trespass, whether it be for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.
controles.kjv: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.
controles.livre: Sobre todo negócio de fraude, sobre boi, sobre asno, sobre ovelha, sobre roupa, sobre toda coisa perdida, quando um disser: Isto é meu, a causa de ambos virá diante dos juízes; e o que os juízes condenarem, pagará o dobro a seu próximo.

versos.hebraico: שְׁבֻעַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה תִּהְיֶה֙ בֵּ֣ין שְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם אִם־לֹ֥א שָׁלַ֛ח יָד֖וֹ בִּמְלֶ֣אכֶת רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְלָקַ֥ח בְּעָלָ֖יו וְלֹ֥א יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃

controles.web: “If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies or is injured, or driven away, no man seeing it;
controles.kjv: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:
controles.livre: Se alguém houver dado a seu próximo asno, ou boi, ou ovelha, ou qualquer outro animal a guardar, e se morrer ou se for aleijado, ou for levado sem vê-lo ninguém;

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־גָּנֹ֥ב יִגָּנֵ֖ב מֵעִמּ֑וֹ יְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לִבְעָלָֽיו׃

controles.web: the oath of Yahweh shall be between them both, whether he hasn’t put his hand to his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.
controles.kjv: Then shall an oath of the Lord be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good.
controles.livre: Juramento do SENHOR terá lugar entre ambos de que não lançou sua mão à riqueza de seu próximo: e seu dono o aceitará, e o outro não pagará.

versos.hebraico: אִם־טָרֹ֥ף יִטָּרֵ֖ף יְבִאֵ֣הוּ עֵ֑ד הַטְּרֵפָ֖ה לֹ֥א יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃פ

controles.web: But if it is stolen from him, he shall make restitution to its owner.
controles.kjv: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
controles.livre: Mas se lhe houver sido furtado, ressarcirá a seu dono.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יִשְׁאַ֥ל אִ֛ישׁ מֵעִ֥ם רֵעֵ֖הוּ וְנִשְׁבַּ֣ר אוֹ־מֵ֑ת בְּעָלָ֥יו אֵין־עִמּ֖וֹ שַׁלֵּ֥ם יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃

controles.web: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.
controles.kjv: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.
controles.livre: E se lhe houver sido arrebatado por fera, trará a ele testemunho, e não pagará o arrebatado.

versos.hebraico: אִם־בְּעָלָ֥יו עִמּ֖וֹ לֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑ם אִם־שָׂכִ֣יר ה֔וּא בָּ֖א בִּשְׂכָרֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.
controles.kjv: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.
controles.livre: Porém se alguém houver tomado emprestado animal de seu próximo, e for ferido ou morto, ausente seu dono, deverá pagá-lo.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יְפַתֶּ֣ה אִ֗ישׁ בְּתוּלָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־אֹרָ֖שָׂה וְשָׁכַ֣ב עִמָּ֑הּ מָהֹ֛ר יִמְהָרֶ֥נָּה לּ֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

controles.web: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.
controles.kjv: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire.
controles.livre: Se o dono estava presente, não o pagará. Se era alugado, ele virá por seu aluguel.

versos.hebraico: אִם־מָאֵ֧ן יְמָאֵ֛ן אָבִ֖יהָ לְתִתָּ֣הּ ל֑וֹ כֶּ֣סֶף יִשְׁקֹ֔ל כְּמֹ֖הַר הַבְּתוּלֹֽת׃ס

controles.web: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.
controles.kjv: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.
controles.livre: E se alguém enganar a alguma virgem que não for desposada, e dormir com ela, deverá pagar o dote por ela e tomá-la por mulher.

versos.hebraico: מְכַשֵּׁפָ֖ה לֹ֥א תְחַיֶּֽה׃ס

controles.web: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
controles.kjv: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
controles.livre: Se seu pai não quiser dá-la a ele, ele lhe pesará prata conforme o dote das virgens.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־שֹׁכֵ֥ב עִם־בְּהֵמָ֖ה מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃ס

controles.web: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.
controles.livre: À feiticeira não deixarás que viva.

versos.hebraico: זֹבֵ֥חַ לָאֱלֹהִ֖ים יָֽחֳרָ֑ם בִּלְתִּ֥י לַיהוָ֖ה לְבַדּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.
controles.kjv: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.
controles.livre: Qualquer um que tiver ajuntamento com animal, morrerá.

versos.hebraico: וְגֵ֥ר לֹא־תוֹנֶ֖ה וְלֹ֣א תִלְחָצֶ֑נּוּ כִּֽי־גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to Yahweh only, shall be utterly destroyed.
controles.kjv: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto the Lord only, he shall be utterly destroyed.
controles.livre: O que sacrificar a deuses, exceto a somente o SENHOR, será morto.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־אַלְמָנָ֥ה וְיָת֖וֹם לֹ֥א תְעַנּֽוּן׃

controles.web: “You shall not wrong an alien, neither shall you oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
controles.livre: E ao estrangeiro não enganarás, nem angustiarás, porque estrangeiros fostes vós na terra do Egito.

versos.hebraico: אִם־עַנֵּ֥ה תְעַנֶּ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ כִּ֣י אִם־צָעֹ֤ק יִצְעַק֙ אֵלַ֔י שָׁמֹ֥עַ אֶשְׁמַ֖ע צַעֲקָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.
controles.kjv: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
controles.livre: A nenhuma viúva nem órfão afligireis.

versos.hebraico: וְחָרָ֣ה אַפִּ֔י וְהָרַגְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם בֶּחָ֑רֶב וְהָי֤וּ נְשֵׁיכֶם֙ אַלְמָנ֔וֹת וּבְנֵיכֶ֖ם יְתֹמִֽים׃פ

controles.web: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;
controles.kjv: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;
controles.livre: Que se tu chegas a afligir-lhe, e ele a mim clamar, certamente ouvirei eu seu clamor;

versos.hebraico: אִם־כֶּ֣סֶף׀ תַּלְוֶ֣ה אֶת־עַמִּ֗י אֶת־הֶֽעָנִי֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹא־תִהְיֶ֥ה ל֖וֹ כְּנֹשֶׁ֑ה לֹֽא־תְשִׂימ֥וּן עָלָ֖יו נֶֽשֶׁךְ׃

controles.web: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
controles.kjv: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
controles.livre: E meu furor se acenderá, e vos matarei a espada, e vossas mulheres serão viúvas, e órfãos vossos filhos.

versos.hebraico: אִם־חָבֹ֥ל תַּחְבֹּ֖ל שַׂלְמַ֣ת רֵעֶ֑ךָ עַד־בֹּ֥א הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ תְּשִׁיבֶ֥נּוּ לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor; neither shall you charge him interest.
controles.kjv: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.
controles.livre: Se deres a meu povo dinheiro emprestado, ao pobre que está contigo, não te portarás com ele como agiota, nem lhe imporás juros.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י הִ֤וא כסותה לְבַדָּ֔הּ הִ֥וא שִׂמְלָת֖וֹ לְעֹר֑וֹ בַּמֶּ֣ה יִשְׁכָּ֔ב וְהָיָה֙ כִּֽי־יִצְעַ֣ק אֵלַ֔י וְשָׁמַעְתִּ֖י כִּֽי־חַנּ֥וּן אָֽנִי׃ס

controles.web: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,
controles.kjv: If thou at all take thy neighbour’s raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:
controles.livre: Se tomares em penhor a roupa de teu próximo, a pôr do sol o devolverás a ele:

versos.hebraico: אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֹ֣א תְקַלֵּ֑ל וְנָשִׂ֥יא בְעַמְּךָ֖ לֹ֥א תָאֹֽר׃

controles.web: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.
controles.kjv: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.
controles.livre: Porque somente aquilo é sua coberta, é aquela a roupa para cobrir suas carnes, no que há de dormir: e será que quando ele a mim clamar, eu então lhe ouvirei, porque sou misericordioso.

versos.hebraico: מְלֵאָתְךָ֥ וְדִמְעֲךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְאַחֵ֑ר בְּכ֥וֹר בָּנֶ֖יךָ תִּתֶּן־לִּֽי׃

controles.web: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.
controles.livre: Não insultarás aos juízes, nem amaldiçoarás ao príncipe de teu povo.

versos.hebraico: כֵּֽן־תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לְשֹׁרְךָ֖ לְצֹאנֶ֑ךָ שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה עִם־אִמּ֔וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֖י תִּתְּנוֹ־לִֽי׃

controles.web: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses.   “You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.
controles.livre: Não adiarás as primícias de tua colheita, nem de teu licor, me darás o primogênito de teus filhos.

versos.hebraico: וְאַנְשֵׁי־קֹ֖דֶשׁ תִּהְי֣וּן לִ֑י וּבָשָׂ֨ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֤ה טְרֵפָה֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ לַכֶּ֖לֶב תַּשְׁלִכ֥וּן אֹתֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. Seven days it shall be with its mother, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.
controles.kjv: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.
controles.livre: Assim farás com o de teu boi e de tua ovelha: sete dias estará com sua mãe, e ao oitavo dia me o darás.
